# Hound

> Install and use small, editable desktop-workflow adapters without interrupting the person using
> the computer. Windows x86_64 is currently supported through the Foxhound native helper.

Use Python 3.11 or newer. Hound downloads a pinned, SHA-256-verified Foxhound helper. Configure the
registry below, inspect compatible adapters, and install only the adapter required for the task.

## Start

- [Quickstart](https://hound.clarksaben.com/quickstart.md): Exact installation and verification commands.
- [Adapter registry](https://hound.clarksaben.com/index.json): Machine-readable `hound.registry/v1` index.
- [Hound source](https://github.com/csaben/hound): CLI, SDK, schema command, examples, and tests.
- [Foxhound source](https://github.com/csaben/foxhound): Native backend source and checksummed releases.

## Agent workflow

- Run `hound setup --json` and `hound check --json` first.
- Set `HOUND_REGISTRY_URL=https://hound.clarksaben.com/index.json`.
- Run `hound adapters search --json`; install only a compatible adapter.
- Installed adapters are editable under `~/.hound/adapters`.
- Run `hound adapter-schema --json` before authoring or modifying an adapter.
- Use `hound chain CHAIN.yaml --tutorial --json` for ordered multi-application workflows.
- Use `--tutorial` when the requested deliverable is a captioned demonstration.

- [Project README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/csaben/hound/main/README.md): Complete behavior, evidence, SDK, and benchmark notes.
